subject: Compute delta final: GSB 25 tests, Vk83, 610 integration, TGP2 4KiB cap fixed; SIGSEGV tool defect confirmed
body:
Authoritative compute delta state (no native/Mesa build):
pipeline_format.h 51cf599d (adds TEGU_PIPELINE2_MAX_CODE=1MiB; TGP1 cap remains4096), air_bridge.h eea1de13 (GSB view_type/aspect authoritative), air_bridge.rs 590ff6b7, compute_frontend.m 2b1076be (device-init factory uses if(&tegu_mali_compile_compute_v2), avoiding ARM64 pointer-bool), runtime_pipeline cad3849b, bridge ae293c43 (unchanged base; textures TDG2 patch not applied), cdylib 8861e0a0.

Rust 25/25 PASS: Vk83 Half2 fetch admit/refuse, bounded 2D mip + 2DArray state only on specialized path, real 4-level mip plan, exact view fields, zero-constant specialization owned clone. Producer 7/7 persisted build/compute-v2-producer-current-abi/result.json with source590/dispatch8861/compiler ea4454b7. Integration release+ASan 610/610 incl ABI, TGP2 156, job113, draw_v2 23, Vk83 13, producer59, corpus graphics (00086/00498/01278), render cache, legacy sampler guards. Evidence workers/compute/evidence-integration-final.json.

Two cross-owner handoffs:
1. SIGSEGV: confirmed audit-tool UAF (specialize_library returns base for rows=[] then caller closes it); not air_bridge. Corpus/root own fix; integration now shows the 3 cases pass/refuse.
2. 30 generic TGP2 refusals: root cause is TGP1 4096-byte code cap in parse2; dumped 14 real packets all 4864..14848 bytes parse rc0 with 51cf. Needs lowering L2 Mesa rebuild to put new header into libnord2_mali_runtime and rerun histogram. TGP1 unchanged.
Textures TDG2 mip/layer patch is ACKed as a contiguous-linear convention but NOT applied: current Rust producer has only level0 row_stride/span, so claiming mip transport now would be unsafe; requires producer wire extension or explicit per-level facts. No phone/publish.
